propositions: The inbound fetcher currently processes only one tracker project per snapshot, causing parent/comment/issuelink enrichment data to be silently dropped for all but one project in a multi-project mapping.
Inbound-created tickets do not record their source project, leaving bridge_project and repos fields unset.

The fetcher must fan out per project in the store mapping, issuing one active/done JQL pair and running all three enrichment passes scoped to each project key, merging results into a shared snapshot deduped by seen_keys.
Source project is derived from the jira key prefix and repos are looked up from the project mapping; both must be stamped on CREATE events via a new projects_store helper.
Per-project truncation ceiling ensures a busy project cannot exhaust the shared budget on behalf of others.
Single-project (unseeded mapping) behavior must remain byte-for-byte identical to pre-change code.
